name: Band Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with the band under your feet and rest your forearms on your thighs with palms down and wrists beyond your knees.
Lift your knuckles by bending your wrists back against the band.
Lower your hands slowly below forearm level.
tips: Keep your forearms pressed flat against your thighs throughout the curl.
Move through a slow, controlled range without jerking your wrists upward.
